# unifi_spatial_record (Data Source)

The `unifi_spatial_record` data source retrieves an existing spatial record by name or id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing spatial record by name.
data "unifi_spatial_record" "floor_1" {
  name = "Floor 1 layout"
}

output "spatial_record_devices" {
  value = data.unifi_spatial_record.floor_1.devices
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the spatial record to look up. Either `name` or `id` must be set.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) The devices placed within this spatial record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `mac` (String) The MAC address of the placed device.
- `position` (Attributes) The x/y/z position of the device within the mapped space. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices--position))

<a id="nestedatt--devices--position"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices.position`

Read-Only:

- `x` (Number) The X coordinate.
- `y` (Number) The Y coordinate.
- `z` (Number) The Z coordinate.
